findings.title: unterminated-fence advisory emitted from the shared classifyAcceptanceCriteria helper
findings.action: keep spec-mandated placement; advisory-only side effect
findings.disposition_rationale: Placement inside classifyAcceptanceCriteria is spec-mandated (section 4 pseudocode); the round-2 QA objection on this exact point was judge-ruled AFFIRM_SPEC. Advisory-only stderr side effect: changes no returned text, breaks the byte-identical no-op text guarantee in no way, and fails no selftest.
